notes.title: Mystic Brews Is Out Now! 🧙
notes.content:

[/p][p]All feedback and opinions are welcome![/p][p]Join the official [url="https://discord.gg/znKeXgdUFQ"]discord server[/url] and give any comment about the game ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]Every patch and updates made will be [b]100% free[/b] in the future! 😎[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for trying it out,[/p][p]Have a good day and brew some potions![/p]
